task_scope: Endpoint/identity adjudication and authoring recommendation only. No maintained changes, record draft, canonical scientific approval, or claim of source exhaustion.

recommendation.status: Scientifically viable for a complete seven-transformation source-defined formal-net draft, subject to independent review and the restrictions below.
recommendation.boundary: Preserve I/A/B/E/H/F/C, all seven native objects, all current balanced Rhea side entries, exact Newman protein scope and supported assemblies. The precursor module is mandatory; a four-step siderophore-assembly subset is not the full PWY-8008 record.
recommendation.endpoint_decision: Use the current independently issued Rhea terminal reaction and its open-chain ChEBI product without changing its equation or pretending it is the cyclic structure. Describe this as the database formal open-chain net convention. Preserve the independently observed cyclic hemiaminal and equilibrium explicitly in the record description, terminal-edge evidence and a separately identified primary/source conflict reference.
recommendation.why_this_can_be_truthful: The source-defined seven enzyme transformations do not specify a separate ring-chain equilibration step. The primary SI directly demonstrates a cyclic SB epimer mixture and equilibrating lactamization, so the molecular-state limitation is explicit rather than suppressed. A formal net product convention need not assert that the represented open-chain species is the dominant free physiological species. All enzymatic transformations remain represented.
recommendation.what_it_does_not_establish: No direct observation of an exclusively linear free Newman product, no measured in vivo linear/cyclic distribution, no spontaneous-reaction rate or condition model, no exact identity between linear and cyclic structures, and no measured five-ATP-per-SB yield.
recommendation.independent_review_question: Does each terminal graph claim remain a faithfully scoped source assertion about the formal net equation, rather than silently asserting an experimentally demonstrated linear-only biological endpoint? If this distinction cannot be made clear in the maintained graph, withhold the complete candidate instead of truncating it or substituting the cyclic structure under a linear ID.
recommendation.optional_future_surface: The newly verified cyclic PubChem CID can be retained as an authentic conflict-reference identity now. A named cyclic participant would need real PubChem authority extraction/policy support before canonical use. A pathway-level observed-output relation is possible only after independent assessment of its evidence and scope; do not fabricate an eighth reaction or modify RHEA59133 to use a different product.

facts: Synthetic SB is characterized as a 1:1 mixture of two epimers due to equilibrating lactamization. NMR data are for the mixture, without assigning A/B resonances to individual epimers.
The terminal five-membered hemiaminal and its unspecified additional stereocenter are visible in the structures; the fixed amino-acid and citrate stereocenters are S.
The reported free-SB NMR conditions differ from the prior natural-source comparison. Do not generalize those conditions to the Newman intracellular distribution.
The separate SBimide conversion to SB is not the same transformation as open-chain/hemiaminal equilibration.
The pH>10 statement in S4 concerns an earlier synthetic fragment, not a measured Newman SB distribution, and is not transferred.
primary_si.primary_main_limit: Publisher/indexed abstract and official publisher SI inspected. The 2015 full main original was not obtained; no invented local main-article digest. Abstract biological recovery refers to USA300 JE2, not Newman.

cyclic_issued_identity.provenance: PubChem substance SID318735782 version2, deposited Nikkaji J3.449.064C, carries the SB alias and cyclic structure. Current compound PUGView lists SB among Removed Synonyms; synonym endpoint404 is preserved. Therefore use the current systematic compound name, not a supposedly current canonical SB alias. cyclic_issued_identity.stereochemical_scope: Two fixed S centers plus unspecified hemiaminal stereocenter. It denotes the neutral cyclic structural class, not one isolated hemiaminal epimer or the Rhea dianion.
cyclic_issued_identity.bridge_limit: Exact isomeric identity to a human transcription of the visually inspected original SI structure was computationally verified. The transcription is not an issuing source and does not itself create an identifier.

sbnB_followup.title: Siderophore-mediated iron metabolism in Staphylococcus aureus
sbnB_followup.author: Marek John Kobylarz
sbnB_followup.provenance: Original author thesis hosted by Library and Archives Canada. Preface printediv-v/PDF4-5 explicitly identifies Chapter4 as assembled from the 2014 published manuscript (PMID24485762). Cite the thesis under its independently issued DOI; do not present it as downloaded journal full text.

inspected_locators.fact: sbnB came from Newman genomic DNA; N-terminal His-tagged heterologous construct, with tag removal in purification. E.coli is an expression host, not the biological source.
Coupled forward NADH formation and reverse ACEGA production support ACEGA+NAD oxidative hydrolysis to DAP+2-oxoglutarate+NADH; reversibility is observed under assay conditions.
SbnA/B-derived precursors enter the full assembly in vitro; iron-chelation and receptor-dependent growth readouts support functional SB, not a terminal free-product microstate determination.

Solution SbnB is predominantly dimeric, 81kDa by dynamic scattering and71kDa by MALS versus approximately38kDa monomer. This supports native CPLX9313 without treating crystal packing alone as assembly proof.
NAD is a consumed redox substrate, not merely a prosthetic cofactor. Proposed hydride-transfer/water-attack residue-level mechanism remains explicitly proposed.

sbnB_followup.remaining_limit: The publisher journal body itself remains403. The thesis provides inspectable author-original full chapter and methods, not proof that every word is identical to the final journal version. Exact engineered construct sequence is not inferred solely from the genome accession.

whole_route_preservation.retained_actual_result: Prior actual original-source replay passed7directions/40sides/7balances. No reaction or source-body change in this endpoint adjudication; unchanged bodies and receipts rehashed rather than relabeling a replay as newly executed.
whole_route_preservation.atp_scope: Five ATP per formal SB is a network sum: two ATP-to-ADP kinase turnovers and three ATP-to-AMP ligations. It is not a direct measured ATP/product ratio or cellular energetic yield.
whole_route_preservation.protein_scope: All seven selected versioned Newman NCBI proteins retain exact genome-CDS and full current UniProt sequence bridges from the sealed prior dossier. Do not relabel NCTC8325 UniProt provenance as Newman; experimental constructs and relevant other experimental strains remain explicit.
whole_route_preservation.assemblies: Retain native SbnI CPLX9312 and SbnB CPLX9313 where supported. SbnA and SbnH dimer observations do not mint new assembly IDs; functional protein roles must not imply monomer sufficiency. SbnC/E/F monomer/dimer mixtures remain unresolved, not fixed stoichiometries.
whole_route_preservation.outside_boundary: SbnG citrate supply, SbnD transport, iron-complex formation and cellular ring-chain distribution are biologically relevant but are not additional members of the exact seven-object PWY8008 definition. Retain their disposition, not a false assertion of biological absence.
